items.guidance: Read deploy/supervisord.conf to identify the two programs; one is likely the Express web server and the other likely matches the declared worker `node dist/worker.js`, which can become the Procfile or package.json worker entry. Point the Dockerfile's default command at the compiled web entry under dist rather than supervisord, and keep any dev server (nodemon, ts-node) out of production. Report if the second program is something other than that worker.

Search the source for migration files or SQL run through pg at startup (for example a migrations folder, a schema.sql, or CREATE TABLE statements executed in the server or worker entry). If a runner such as node-pg-migrate is already a dependency, report its non-interactive command against DATABASE_URL using the compiled output in the image. Otherwise report that no migration mechanism exists.
